editorial:
You meet Jonathan Merrick, a successful writer who gets pulled into a dark romance with Ligeia, a stunning woman who refuses to let death win. The story mixes gothic horror, obsession, and supernatural danger, so you can expect creepy mansions, strange rituals, and a love story that feels more like a trap. It is not a fast jump-scare ride; instead, it leans on mood, mystery, and the slow pull of Ligeia’s control.

The acting gives you a few strong moments, especially from the leads, and the dark atmosphere keeps things interesting even when the plot gets messy. Some scenes feel slow, and the story can be confusing if you want clear answers, but fans of gothic horror may still enjoy the strange mood. If you like dark romance and supernatural thrillers, give it a try. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or pick up the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Ligeia’s plan to cheat death is revealed: she has been using dark magic to move her soul into another body. Jonathan finally sees the truth and fights to stop her, but the last twist shows that even when her body fails, Ligeia’s will survives. The ending leaves you with the idea that death cannot be beaten so easily, and Jonathan pays a heavy price for loving her.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves gothic horror and dark romance.
